summary: Today features significant legal developments, including court rulings and regulatory actions that may impact various sectors, particularly in retail and governance.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court halts the release of Sonakshi Sinha's film 'Tu Hai Meri Kiran'.
Supreme Court stays the probe against Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan in the CMRL case for one week.
Supreme Court upholds Clause 10 of T.N. Special Absorption Rules, ranking 1983 direct recruits higher than special appointees.
BL Agro plans to invest Rs 7,000 crore in Tanzania, targeting Rs 30,000 crore revenue by FY29.
Surging gold prices led to a 15% year-on-year fall in jewellery sales during the festive season.
